reason: Primary purpose is a Wishadel-themed visual redesign for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with substantial integrated workbench features including task execution, Git operations, file editing, browser access, and terminal control.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供维什戴尔风格主题，并集成任务看板、Git 图谱、文件、浏览器和终端工作台。
summaries.en: A Wishadel-themed interface plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with integrated task board, Git graph, file, browser, and terminal workbench features.

capabilities: Applies a visual theme and responsive layout to the host web GUI
Provides task board scheduling and invokes DSH agent sessions for task execution
Displays Git branches, history, workspace changes, diffs, and supports staging, unstaging, discarding, and committing changes
Provides file browsing, preview, editing, and saving for supported file types
Provides a session-isolated terminal with command input, output, stopping, and clearing
Provides an embedded HTTP/HTTPS browser panel
Persists settings, task, and workbench state through host-side storage and same-origin routes
